texts.en:
A small percentage of our test subjects are suffering adverse reactions to augmentation. Their bodies are rejecting the implants, bringing life-threatening side-effects. The cause seems to be a genetic defect, previously unnoticed. According to preliminary calculations, this affects around 5% of our drone population.

Having identified the issue, we can now screen our drones to prevent it, but we don't know what to do with the affected population.

# 隐性问题 / One Invisible Issue

- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13
- 来源 Sources：`events/machine_age_situation_events_1.txt:6448-6548`；`common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt`

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 蜂巢版网络化局势（Cyberization）每月从 on_cyberization_hive_situation_random_events_list 等权重抽取一个满足条件的随机事件（共6个：2220、2260、2320、2360、2420、2460）；事件期间设置 situation_cyberization_pause。
  The hive version of the Cyberization situation draws one valid event with equal weight monthly from on_cyberization_hive_situation_random_events_list (six events: 2220, 2260, 2320, 2360, 2420, 2460); the event sets situation_cyberization_pause while open.
- 触发：局势进度>250，且拥有至少一个有蜂巢意识特质但没有“赛博”特质的人口群；每局至多一次。
  Trigger: situation progress > 250 and a pop group with the Hive Mind trait but not the Cybernetic trait; at most once.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 「看不见的问题」（挑战）：选项——设标准（cyber_hive_standards，12个月暂停局势）；接受遗传缺陷（cyber_hive_genetic_defects 局势标志）；或长期（60个月）暂停。
  "One Invisible Issue" (challenge): options: set standards (cyber_hive_standards, situation paused 12 months); accept genetic defects (cyber_hive_genetic_defects situation flag); or a long (60 months) pause.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 单个窗口（无后续或只通向共享结局）；选项互斥，只能选一个。
  A single window (no follow-up, or only into the shared ending); options are exclusive, only one is chosen.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 选项集合随帝国的伦理、权威、政体特质而变，见条件。
  The available options vary with ethics, authority and civics, see the conditions.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对：来源池与权重、触发条件、选项分支与目标事件。
  Checked: source pool and weights, trigger conditions, option branches and target events.
- 未逐行核对选项的数值收益，只记录其性质（修正名、资源、标志）。
  Option numbers were not checked line by line; only their nature (modifier names, resources, flags) is recorded.
